description: List the legal-norm references Matrix recognized in a context's text ('§ 25a KWG', 'Art. 28 DORA', 'AT 4.3 MaRisk' - normalized keys): without chunk_ids every referenced norm with how many chunks cite it and the first chunk ids, most cited first (an overview of what a collection depends on); with chunk_ids the references of exactly those chunks (follow a passage's cross-references, then lookup_exact or find_citing_chunks for the targets). contains filters the keys.

contains.description: Only keys containing this text (case-insensitive), e.g. 'KWG'.

name: list_norm_references
